description: This file manages Matrix account configuration, including resolving account IDs, environment variables, and account entries for the Matrix integration within the openclaw plugin SDK.

methods.name: resolveMatrixChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves the matrix channel configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig object.

methods.name: findMatrixAccountEntry
methods.description: Finds a specific matrix account entry in the configuration based on account ID.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredMatrixAccountIds
methods.description: Resolves the list of configured matrix account IDs, including environment-based and default accounts.

methods.name: resolveMatrixDefaultOrOnlyAccountId
methods.description: Determines the default or only matrix account ID based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: requiresExplicitMatrixDefaultAccount
methods.description: Checks if an explicit default matrix account is required based on configuration and environment.
